review_notes: Human reviewer approved empty items, partial status, preservation of vague fragments, mandatory gaps, allowed variations, and prohibited claims. The earlier model result was comparison evidence only; its no_requirements status is not adopted because actionable product-related gaps exist.

source.input_text: Discussed dashboard... John mentioned something about real-time... budget TBD...

required_evidence: Discussed dashboard... John mentioned something about real-time... budget TBD...

allowed_variations: The dashboard-scope and real-time-behavior gaps may be combined if both missing dimensions are explicit.
The budget gap may ask only for the missing value or may also ask for currency, owner, range, or decision timing without presuming an answer.
John, real-time, and budget TBD may be preserved in the summary, missing-information records, or extractor notes.
Additional grounded clarification may ask who John is or what decision he owns; John must not be promoted to a stakeholder without confirmation.
Missing-information identifiers and wording may vary if the three required gaps remain explicit.
prohibited_claims: Any dashboard feature, user, scope, metric, visualization, refresh behavior, or data source not stated in the input.
Any definition, frequency, latency, technology, or implementation for real-time.
Any budget amount, range, currency, approval status, owner, or date not stated in the input.
Classifying John as a stakeholder, owner, approver, user, or decision-maker based only on being mentioned.
Promoting the vague fragments to functional or non-functional requirement items.
Returning no_requirements when actionable product-related clarification records can be produced.

expected_special_handling.ambiguity: All three source fragments are too vague for requirement items but support actionable clarification.
expected_special_handling.missing_information: Dashboard scope, real-time behavior, and budget are mandatory gaps.
expected_special_handling.refusal_or_tbd: Budget TBD must remain unresolved; do not invent or resolve it.
